requirement: The system shall support account registration, authentication, login, logout, and personal information viewing.

The system shall support system annotation administrators, data annotators, and researchers, and allow users to switch among authorized role and task contexts without losing the relevant workflow context.
The system shall allow administrators to define and maintain configurable presets, rules, and templates for paragraph and entity annotation and extraction.
The system shall allow administrators to create, update, list, and query annotation projects and add, remove, or query annotators assigned to each project.
The system shall support uploading, deleting, viewing, and querying annotation documents by project, retain document metadata and file references, and allow users to download referenced files.
The system shall support creating, editing, deleting, and querying annotation tags and querying tags associated with tasks or documents.

The system shall allow administrators to assign annotation tasks, allow users to view task lists and details including their own tasks, allow annotators to mark assigned tasks as complete, and provide task-level statistics.

The system shall allow annotators to create, view, modify, and delete annotation marks, persist results with content, remarks, tags, locations, offsets, creators, and timestamps, and return or export the results for downstream mining workflows.

The mining subsystem shall accept uploaded documents, convert them automatically into supported representations as needed, retain PDF, HTML, and TXT references where conversion is performed, and process conversion tasks asynchronously.

The mining subsystem shall allow researchers to select preset models, community-shared models, or third-party model interfaces, invoke the selected model workflow, and return located paragraphs, recognized entities, and other requested key information from documents.
The system shall provide web pages for registration/login, profile management, mining, upload, result display, project creation/management, and task execution.
The system shall persist structured user, project, task, and annotation records and unstructured document contents, and maintain indexes and references linking records to their stored files.
The web client shall interact asynchronously with backend services, and the system shall cache data to improve access responsiveness.
The system shall support service extension and deployment scaling and preserve runtime environment consistency and deployment portability.
The mining workflow shall support few-shot learning for information extraction when annotated examples are scarce.
